record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.original_question: Is the measure-isomorphism relation on ergodic measure-preserving transformations of the unit interval bi-reducible with the maximal Polish group action?

evidence.quote: Question 1.17. Is the measure isomorphism relation on ergodic measure-preserving transformations of the unit interval bi-reducible with the maximal Polish group action?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $([0,1], \lambda)$ denote the unit interval equipped with Lebesgue measure. Let $\mathrm{MPT}([0,1],\lambda)$ be the Polish group of (equivalence classes mod null sets of) invertible measure-preserving transformations of $([0,1],\lambda)$, endowed with the weak topology, and let $\mathrm{EMPT}([0,1],\lambda) \subseteq \mathrm{MPT}([0,1],\lambda)$ be the subset of ergodic transformations. Two transformations $S, T \in \mathrm{EMPT}([0,1],\lambda)$ are said to be measure-isomorphic, written $S \cong T$, if there exists $\varphi \in \mathrm{MPT}([0,1],\lambda)$ such that $\varphi \circ S = T \circ \varphi$ almost everywhere; this defines an analytic equivalence relation on $\mathrm{EMPT}([0,1],\lambda)$.

Recall that for analytic equivalence relations $E$ on a Polish space $X$ and $F$ on a Polish space $Y$, $E$ is Borel reducible to $F$, written $E \le_B F$, if there exists a Borel map $f \colon X \to Y$ such that $x \mathrel{E} x' \iff f(x) \mathrel{F} f(x')$. The relations $E$ and $F$ are Borel bi-reducible, $E \sim_B F$, when $E \le_B F$ and $F \le_B E$. An equivalence relation is called a maximal (or universal) orbit equivalence relation induced by a Polish group action if every orbit equivalence relation arising from a continuous action of a Polish group on a Polish space Borel reduces to it; such a maximal relation exists and is unique up to Borel bi-reducibility (e.g., realized by the action of the homeomorphism group of $[0,1]^{\mathbb{N}}$ on a suitable space).

Question: Is the measure-isomorphism equivalence relation on $\mathrm{EMPT}([0,1],\lambda)$ Borel bi-reducible with the maximal orbit equivalence relation induced by a Polish group action?
artifact.category_tag: Borel equivalence relations in ergodic theory
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2025) by Le Maître and Sabok and others has shown partial negative results about reducibility of the isomorphism relation of ergodic measure-preserving transformations to certain Polish group actions (e.g., it is not Borel reducible to the conjugacy action of the full group on itself), but these results do not resolve whether the relation is Borel bi-reducible with the maximal Polish group action. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Unbalancedness of the conjugacy relation of ergodic measure-preserving transformations
status_evidence.snippet: The isomorphism of ergodic measure-preserving transformations is not Borel reducible to the relation induced by the conjugacy action of the full group of an ergodic measure-preserving transformation on itself.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial results restrict reducibility behavior but do not establish bi-reducibility with the maximal Polish group action.
